tip.1: Press F for the flight mode wheel; pick with the mouse or right stick.
tip.2: F1 shows every shortcut on any screen.
tip.3: Change stick mode (Mode 1–4) in the Fly wizard or the pause menu.
tip.4: On fixed-wing, G toggles classic cockpit instruments.
tip.5: The flight discipline grade (A–F) comes from alerts — acknowledge with B.
tip.6: Connect Mission Planner on UDP 14550 to upload missions.
tip.7: Compare speed, range, durability and agility per type in the Hangar.
tip.8: Ring race against AI: Match → local race.
top10.note: Scores are computed only from server-verified flights and matches (signed in + cloud flight / match). Guest flights are local records.
tracks.name: Name
tut.b1: Fly drones, planes, VTOLs and rovers with real ArduPilot physics. Use mouse, keyboard or gamepad in the menus.
tut.b2: Pick, paint and tune your vehicle in the Hangar and watch it spin in 3D.
tut.b3: In the Fly wizard pick the map, time, weather and wind; ready Fab maps and your own tracks are listed.
tut.b4: Choose your stick mode (Mode 1–4). In Mode 2 the left stick is throttle/yaw, the right pitch/roll; on keyboard WASD is left, arrows are right.
tut.b5: In flight: X to ARM, T to take off; F opens the mode wheel, Esc pauses. On fixed-wing, G shows cockpit instruments.
tut.b6: F1 opens shortcut help on any screen. Rebind keys in Settings → Key bindings. Have a great flight!
